article.summary_es: Eglise Baptiste de la Communion Fraternelle es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre los sábados de 12pm a 2pm.
article.summary_en: Eglise Baptiste de la Communion Fraternelle is a food pantry in Brooklyn listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open Saturdays from 12pm to 2pm.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC.
Está ubicada en 2549 Church Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11226.
Puede llamar al (718) 693-8214 para preguntar antes de ir.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si pide requisitos.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 2549 Church Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11226.
It is open Saturdays from 12pm to 2pm.
You can call (718) 693-8214 to ask before visiting.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements.
